query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as "count!"
               FROM holidays h
               WHERE h.workspace_id = $1
                 AND h.is_paid = false
                 AND h.date >= $2
                 AND h.date <= $3
                 AND NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM leave_requests lr
                     WHERE lr.employee_id = $4
                       AND lr.status IN ('approved', 'pre_approved')
                       AND lr.start_date <= h.date
                       AND lr.end_date >= h.date
                 )
